vault_address.description: Vault server URL. Falls back to the VAULT_ADDR environment variable.

vault_approle_path.description: Mount path for the AppRole auth method. Defaults to 'approle'.

vault_role_id.description: AppRole role ID. Falls back to the VAULT_ROLE_ID environment variable. Must be used together with vault_secret_id. Mutually exclusive with vault_token.

vault_secret_id.description: AppRole secret ID. Falls back to the VAULT_SECRET_ID environment variable. Must be used together with vault_role_id. Mutually exclusive with vault_token.

vault_token.description: Vault token. Falls back to the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable. Mutually exclusive with vault_role_id / vault_secret_id.

vault_transit_engine.description: Mount path for the Vault Transit secrets engine. Defaults to 'transit'.

block.description: Encrypt secrets using SOPS with HashiCorp Vault Transit as the key backend.

ciphertext.description: SOPS-encrypted JSON document. Decryptable with `sops -d --input-type json`.

content.description: JSON-encoded document to encrypt. Use jsonencode() to build the structure.

encrypted_regex.description: Only keys whose names match this regex are encrypted. Mutually exclusive with other scope options.

encrypted_suffix.description: Only keys whose names end with this suffix are encrypted. Mutually exclusive with other scope options.

pretty.description: Indent the SOPS JSON output. Defaults to false.

unencrypted_regex.description: Keys whose names match this regex are left in plaintext. Mutually exclusive with other scope options.

unencrypted_suffix.description: Keys whose names end with this suffix are left in plaintext. Mutually exclusive with other scope options.

vault_key_name.description: Name of the Vault Transit key used to wrap the data key.

vault_transit_engine.description: Vault Transit mount path for this resource. Overrides the provider-level vault_transit_engine. Defaults to 'transit'.

ciphertext.description: SOPS-encrypted YAML 1.2 document. Decryptable with `sops -d --input-type yaml`.

content.description: JSON-encoded document to encrypt. Use jsonencode() to build the structure. The output is YAML regardless of this input format.

encrypted_regex.description: Only keys whose names match this regex are encrypted. Mutually exclusive with other scope options.

encrypted_suffix.description: Only keys whose names end with this suffix are encrypted. Mutually exclusive with other scope options.

unencrypted_regex.description: Keys whose names match this regex are left in plaintext. Mutually exclusive with other scope options.

unencrypted_suffix.description: Keys whose names end with this suffix are left in plaintext. Mutually exclusive with other scope options.

vault_key_name.description: Name of the Vault Transit key used to wrap the data key.

vault_transit_engine.description: Vault Transit mount path for this resource. Overrides the provider-level vault_transit_engine. Defaults to 'transit'.

path_regexes.description:
Path regexes for which the Vault Transit key is applied. Each regex
becomes one creation_rule entry in the output. When omitted, a single
catch-all creation_rule is generated with no path_regex, matching all files.

vault_key_name.description: Name of the Vault Transit key referenced in every creation rule.

vault_transit_engine.description: Vault Transit mount path for this data source. Overrides the provider-level vault_transit_engine. Defaults to 'transit'.
